business_problem: Insurance business Canopius needed to upgrade its technical infrastructure.
solution_summary: Insurance business Canopius needed to upgrade its technical infrastructure. They chose to migrate away from dual datacentres to Microsoft Azure, leveraging native tooling, including Azure VMware Solution. Twist to Azure Graeme Phillips, Chief Information Officer at Canopius expands, “The ‘stick or twist’ moment came when we thought: do we just go ahead with our normal hardware refresh or do we put the foundations in place that will allow us to use all the upcoming technologies when it comes to Microsoft Copilot , Artificial Intelligence (AI) and positioning the data where we need it to be to operate in different territories.” The Canopius team recognised that a migration to Microsoft Azure would better facilitate its ambitions across its international markets, as well as providing the right basis for future innovations, especially around AI. Now, Canopius can respond faster to market and business needs.

solution_components.name: Azure VMware Solution
solution_components.role: Supports migration of VMware workloads into Azure while preserving existing tooling.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI assistant inside Microsoft 365 workflows for employees.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the secure, scalable cloud foundation for the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure Compute Gallery
solution_components.role: Standardizes and distributes compute images across Azure environments.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes and analyzes large datasets for the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Trains and operationalizes machine learning models used by the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides large-scale analytics and data processing for the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Studio
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for building, testing, and deploying the AI assistant or agent solution.

Founded in December 2003, with £25m equity capital and achieved significant growth through a mix of organic expansion and acquisition, Canopius is privately owned, backed by private equity funding.
To maximise the competitive advantage from the data it holds, Canopius wanted to migrate from dual datacentres to a more agile, cost-effective and geographically scalable cloud environment.

“The challenge we had in our previous environment,” explains Jonathan Hogg, Head of IT Service Management at Canopius, “was around cost management and the availability of our global platform.” Stick or twist?
In 2023, it began a migration project which leveraged many native Azure services to ease and hasten the migration process.
More than 500 servers were migrated to Azure over a six-month period.

Canopius does not see itself as a technology infrastructure owner – we benefit from Azure taking care of that – while we own the processing.” Competitive advantage through data Robert Welburn adds, “The ability to process that data quickly is what is key to Azure.” Being able to leverage its data with the scalability, agility, elasticity and cost-effectiveness of Microsoft Azure brings significant competitive advantage.
